sql: SELECT SUM(n.value) FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh JOIN dim d ON d.fact_id = n.fact_id WHERE s.name = 'SOUTHERN CO' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 1 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND d.axis = 'LegalEntity'  AND n.ndims = 1
